newsitem.title: UK: Brammer acquires Abec for 7.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Brammer acquires Abec for 7.6 mln stg.

text.p: Brammer Plc on Friday said it acquired Abec Group Ltd for a maximum consideration of 7.6 million stg, including 500,000 stg which is dependent on Abec's future performance.
Abec's principal business is the distribution of bearings, power transmission and hydraulic products, seals and fasteners.
Brammer said the acquisition is expected to be immediately earnings enhancing.
In addition to paying a maximum of 7.6 million stg for Abec's entire issued share capital, Brammer said it will assume Abec's borrowings of 860,000 stg.

Brammer said initial consideration of 7.1 million stg will be payable on completion, including 5.4 million in cash, 1.5 million in Brammer new ordinary shares, and 200,000 stg in unsecured loan notes.
The 500,000 stg in deferred compensation, dependent on Abec's future performance, will be payble in Brammer new ordinary shares in November 1998.
